per_room_toolbox_assignment.description: Every room now has its own assigned Toolbox. The Toolbox acts as the coordinator that gathers the room team to fix issues.
per_room_toolbox_assignment.role_of_toolbox: When an issue is detected in a room (security breach, corruption, damage, performance problem), the room's Toolbox gathers the most qualified agents present in or near that room to form a temporary repair team.
per_room_toolbox_assignment.integration: Toolbox works with Jeeves delegation, the Agentic Queue, and the Nav Map to efficiently assemble and manage repair teams.
